questions.explanation: Generic plurals take no article: 'Tigers are endangered'.
'The + singular' can define a whole species: 'The tiger is...'.
Abstract nouns take no article in generic statements.
options: The honesty is the best policy.
A honesty is the best policy.

questions.explanation: Instruments take 'the': 'plays the piano'.
Uncountable nouns take no article in generic statements: 'Water is essential'.
'Go to school' (purpose) takes no article; 'the school' means the building.
questions.q: He goes to ___ school by bus.

questions.explanation: Most mountain names take no article: 'Mount Everest'.
questions.q: ___ Mount Everest is the highest peak.

questions.explanation: 'The + adjective' refers to a group: 'the rich'.
Uncountable nouns can take 'a' with an adjective: 'a good knowledge'.
questions.q: She has ___ good knowledge of Japanese.

questions.explanation: 'Life' in a generic sense takes no article.
options: The life is full of surprises.
A life is full of surprises.
The life is full of surprise.

questions.explanation: Plural country names take 'the': 'the United States'.
questions.q: ___ United States is a large country.

questions.explanation: Generic plural nouns take no article: 'Dogs make loyal pets'.
A specific hospital visit takes 'the'.
questions.q: He was taken to ___ hospital near his house.

questions.explanation: 'The history of...' specifies which history, so use 'the'.
Institutions for their purpose take no article: 'went to church to pray'.
options: The gold is expensive these days.
He went to the church to pray.
questions.q: Find the sentence with a mistake.

questions.explanation: Abstract nouns in generic statements take no article.
'The + singular noun' defines a species: 'The whale is...'.
Named hotels take 'the': 'the Ritz Hotel'.
'In prison' (as a prisoner) takes no article.
options: She's in the prison for theft.
She's in a prison for theft.
She's in prison for the theft.

questions.explanation: The defining clause makes it specific: 'The information you gave me'.
questions.q: ___ information you gave me was useful.
